preamble:
NOTICE keeps the short human-readable list of the notices liquid's own binaries carry; this file is
the complete list with the license texts. Versions of system libraries are the ones installed where
liquid is built.

components.name: Boost.Capy
components.use: submodule, linked publicly by libliquid

components.use: submodule, linked privately

components.name: automerge-cpp
components.use: submodule, linked privately
components.note: automerge-cpp is Steve Sperandeo's MIT library, public at https://github.com/homer6/automerge-cpp; liquid pins a copy of it. Its own third-party notices (for example the nlohmann/json copy under upstream/json) are in that repository.

components.name: oramacore-cpp
components.use: submodule, pinned; not built by liquid's CMake today
components.note: oramacore-cpp is Orama Search Inc.'s own library, released with this stack under the same MIT License as this repository.

components.use: fetched at build (SHA-256 pinned), compiled privately

components.license: BSD-3-Clause (dual BSD-3-Clause OR GPL-2.0-only; used under BSD)
components.use: fetched at build, compiled privately

components.name: SHA-256 implementation (Brad Conte, crypto-algorithms)
components.use: vendored in src/hash/
components.text:
The files src/hash/sha256.c and src/hash/sha256.h are Brad Conte's SHA-256 implementation from
https://github.com/B-Con/crypto-algorithms. Its README says: "This code is released into the public
domain free of any restrictions. The author requests acknowledgement if the code is used, but does
not require it. This code is provided free of any liability and without any quality claims by the
author." This entry is that acknowledgement. The files keep their original header and carry no
SPDX tag.

components.name: AppImage type 2 runtime
components.license: MIT (with statically linked LGPL-2.1, BSD-2-Clause, MIT, BSD-3-Clause and Zlib components)
components.use: vendored binaries in third_party/appimage-runtimes/, embedded in liquid

components.name: libfuse (inside the AppImage runtime)
components.version: as built by the runtime at the commit above
components.use: statically linked into the vendored AppImage runtime binaries
components.note: The vendored AppImage runtime statically links libfuse (LGPL-2.1). The runtime's complete source, including the libfuse it builds, is public at https://github.com/AppImage/type2-runtime at the commit above, which also lets a recipient relink it as the LGPL requires.

components.name: squashfuse (inside the AppImage runtime)
components.use: statically linked into the vendored AppImage runtime binaries

components.name: zlib (inside the AppImage runtime; also linked from the system by liquid)
components.use: statically linked into the AppImage runtime; system library for liquid

components.name: OpenSSL
components.use: system library, linked dynamically, not distributed

components.name: libfuse3 (Linux)
components.use: system library, linked dynamically on Linux, not distributed

components.name: macFUSE (macOS, optional)
components.use: optional system library, linked dynamically if installed, not distributed
components.note: macFUSE is optional on macOS and is never bundled. Its license restricts redistribution, so a liquid package for macOS must not include it; users install it themselves.
